concepts.name: Selected glyph
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one original, polished square app icon for MatchStyle, a VS Code extension that selects text by regex and changes its font. Concept 1: a large beautifully drawn lowercase double-storey serif "a", framed by four short, substantial selection-corner brackets. A very dark ink square background, warm ivory letter, fresh mint selection brackets. Typography is the main character, with generous balanced negative space, optically centered, bold enough to read at 32 pixels. Flat vector-like graphic, crisp precise edges, sophisticated typography, a simple memorable silhouette. The icon artwork must fill the entire square canvas edge to edge; no outside page margin, no white presentation border. No wordmark, no additional letters, no captions, no UI mockup, no watermark, no 3D, no shadows, no glow, no gradient, no decorative texture. This is the actual standalone icon asset, not a presentation of an icon.

concepts.name: Split type
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one original, polished square app icon for MatchStyle, a VS Code extension that changes the font of text matched by a regex. Concept 2: one large capital "A", whose two halves have different typographic personalities: one half an elegant strong serif, the other half clean bold geometric sans-serif. The two halves form ONE coherent capital A with a continuous crossbar and shared baseline, not two letters beside each other. This is a clever, beautiful type-designer mark that communicates changing font style. Warm vivid coral square background, ivory letter. Optically centered, approximately 68% of canvas height, balanced wide margins, strong silhouette legible at 32 pixels. Flat vector-like graphic, crisp precise edges, restrained premium aesthetic. Entire canvas is the square icon background, edge to edge. No outside border, no wordmark, no other text, no captions, no divider line, no UI mockup, no watermark, no 3D, no shadows, no gradients, no texture.

concepts.name: Pattern mark
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one original, polished square app icon for MatchStyle, a VS Code extension for regex-based font customization. Concept 3: a striking typographic ligature made from the exact characters "a*" — one oversized bold lowercase double-storey serif a, with a compact crisp six-arm typographic regex asterisk raised to its upper right, closely composed as one unique mark. The asterisk is solid and substantial rather than thin, not a twinkling sparkle or star. Rich golden yellow square background, very dark ink lowercase a, dark teal asterisk. Elegant modern editorial feel, balanced negative space and optical centering, extremely simple and readable at 32 pixels. Flat vector-like graphic, crisp edges, no outside page margin: the square background fills the whole canvas. No extra words, no other letters, no captions, no mockup, no watermark, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no photographic texture.

concepts.name: Custom M
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one original, polished square app icon for MatchStyle, a VS Code extension for matching text and changing its typography. Concept 4: one custom capital "M" monogram with a clever switch of stroke weight: the left upright and left diagonal are thinner but still substantial, the right diagonal and right upright are bold and heavy. The M feels drawn by a type designer, geometrically precise, balanced, instantly recognizable, with a striking stepped shift in typographic weight inside ONE unified glyph. Soft warm ivory square background, strong deep cobalt M, no additional symbol or ornament. Optically centered, large confident mark, approximately 60% of square width and 60% of height, generous negative space. Flat vector-like graphic with immaculate edges; readable at 32 pixels. The square icon background fills the entire canvas edge to edge. No outside page border, no wordmark, no other text, no captions, no UI mockup, no watermark, no gradients, no glow, no shadows, no 3D, no texture.
